Commerce Participants, Pricing & Discounts

Follow this step-by-step sequence to master the domain concepts in order.

1
concept beginner

Merchant

A merchant is the business entity or seller operating an ecommerce store and selling products directly to buyers.

Read Step 1 →
2
concept beginner

Ecommerce Supply Chain

An ecommerce supply chain is the end-to-end network of organizations, resources, activities, and technologies involved in creating and delivering products to shoppers.

Read Step 2 →
3
concept beginner

Retailer

A retailer is a commercial business that purchases goods from manufacturers or distributors and sells them directly to end consumers.

Read Step 3 →
4
concept beginner

Vendor

A vendor is a brand, manufacturer, or supplier that provides products to a merchant for retail sale.

Read Step 4 →
5
comparison beginner

Merchant vs Vendor

Understand the commercial relationship between retail merchants and product suppliers/vendors.

Read Step 5 →
6
concept beginner

Customer

A customer represents an individual or organization purchasing goods or services from an ecommerce store.

Read Step 6 →
7
comparison beginner

User vs Customer

Clarify the technical boundary between backend admin users and storefront customer accounts.

Read Step 7 →
8
concept beginner

Price & Compare-At Price

Price represents the monetary value required to purchase a variant, while Compare-At Price displays the original reference list price for strike-through sales.

Read Step 8 →
9
concept beginner

Discount

A discount is a price reduction applied automatically or via coupon codes to incentives purchases, boost conversion rates, or clear inventory.

Read Step 9 →
10
concept beginner

Coupon & Promo Code

A coupon code is an alphanumeric string entered by a customer at checkout to redeem a specific promotional discount rule.

Read Step 10 →
11
comparison beginner

Discount vs Coupon

Understand the distinction between underlying price reduction rules and customer-facing promo code triggers.
